name: Acıbadem University
description: Acıbadem University is a thematic university in the field of health sciences, founded in 2007 by the Acibadem Health and Education Foundation. The university, which carries the Acibadem culture, which is formed with 25 years of experience and knowledge in health services, to higher education; With its strong academic staff and advanced technological infrastructure, it trains well-equipped health professionals who are open to continuous development.
